{{- /* llms-full.txt: the whole docs + spec corpus as one plain-text Markdown
       stream, in reading order. Walks only the docs and spec section trees, so
       the vanity stubs, home, and 404 are excluded. Each entry emits its title
       as an H1 followed by the page's raw Markdown source. */ -}}
# {{ site.Title }}

> {{ site.Params.description | default "Full documentation corpus for LLM consumption." }}

{{ range (slice (site.GetPage "/docs") (site.GetPage "/spec")) -}}
{{- with . }}{{ template "llms-full-tree" (dict "context" .) }}
{{- end -}}
{{- end -}}

{{- define "llms-full-tree" -}}
{{- $ctx := .context -}}
{{- with $ctx.RawContent }}
{{ printf "# %s" $ctx.Title }}

{{ . }}
{{- end }}
{{ range where $ctx.RegularPages "Params.excludeSearch" "ne" true }}
{{ if not .Params.hideTitle }}{{ printf "# %s" .Title }}

{{ end }}{{ .RawContent }}
{{- end }}
{{- range where $ctx.Sections "Params.excludeSearch" "ne" true -}}
{{ template "llms-full-tree" (dict "context" .) }}
{{- end -}}
{{- end -}}
